intel.company_overview: Postman is an AI-native API platform for engineers and enterprises to design, build, test, manage, and distribute APIs and services across the full API lifecycle. It is widely adopted as the platform where the world's APIs are built and shipped, now integrating native AI capabilities such as an AI Engineer, Agent Mode, and MCP servers to automate API workflows and accelerate development at scale.
intel.target_audience: Software engineers, development teams, and enterprises building, testing, and managing APIs and AI-powered services at scale.

intel.company_overview: Supabase provides a complete, open-source backend platform built around Postgres, bundling authentication, real-time data, storage, edge functions, and vector embeddings into a single developer service. It differentiates itself by offering an integrated dashboard and ready-made starter templates that let developers ship production applications quickly without managing multiple infrastructure components.
intel.target_audience: Developers building full-stack web and mobile applications (React, Next.js, Flutter, React Native) who need a scalable Postgres-powered backend with authentication, storage, and AI/vector capabilities.

intel.company_overview: Vapi is a developer platform for building, testing, and deploying advanced voice AI agents with features including orchestration, real-time monitoring, and enterprise-grade scalability. The platform handles the underlying infrastructure, allowing developers to go from prompt to production quickly while offering compliance certifications (SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI), sub-500ms latency, and reach to 1M+ developers globally.
intel.target_audience: Developers and enterprises building conversational voice AI applications for use cases like customer support, lead qualification, appointment scheduling, and healthcare operations.
